stage.title: Where your tokens go
stage.body: One inspection reads this repository's Claude Code sessions from the last 30 days on this computer and shows where context tokens went, with a change for each finding. It reads counts, model names and times. It shows a message only when you open one turn, and it changes no file.
stage.files: {files, plural, one {# session file} other {# session files}}, {size}, in the last 30 days

run.stopped: Stopped. The figures cover {done} of {total} session files.

strip.title: Context per turn, by day
strip.dayTip: {date}: {perTurn} per turn · {turns, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}}

split.total: {tokens} context tokens in {turns, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}}

detail.longContext: {turns, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}} ({share} of all) ran with more than 200K tokens of context. Every turn reads the whole context again, so these turns processed {tokens} tokens beyond the first 200K each.
detail.start: Sessions began with {median} tokens of context before the first answer, and every later turn carried them. The tool list alone was about {toolTokens} tokens per request.
detail.toolGroup: {name}: about {tokens} tokens · {calls, plural, =0 {never called} one {called once} other {called # times}} in 30 days
detail.estimated: Estimated from the size of the tool list
detail.compaction: Claude Code compacted {count, plural, one {once} other {# times}} in {runs, plural, one {# session} other {# sessions}}, at {before} tokens on average, leaving {after} after each.
detail.cacheMiss: Claude Code reported {count, plural, one {# cache miss} other {# cache misses}}, and {tokens} tokens were written to the cache again.
detail.cacheReason: {reason}: {count, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}} · {tokens} tokens
detail.model: {agent} · {model} · {effort} effort · {turns, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}} · {tokens} tokens

fix.title: What to change
fix.longContext: Start a new session for a new task, or run /clear. autoCompactWindow in .claude/settings.json is {window}; a lower value compacts sooner and keeps less of the conversation.
fix.start: Turn off a tool server you rarely call here with /mcp in Claude Code. Improve checks the memory index Claude Code loads at start.
fix.compaction: At the end of a task, start a new session or run /compact yourself, so the summary falls between tasks.
fix.systemChanged: The system prompt changed during a session, for example after an instruction or memory file was edited. Edit them between sessions.
fix.toolsChanged: The tool list changed during a session, for example when a tool server connected late or was switched. Set tool servers before you start.
fix.modelChanged: The model changed during a session, which starts a new cache. Switch models between tasks.
fix.otherReason: Claude Code says no more about this reason, so Atlas proposes no change.
fix.model: Each agent's model and effort are the model: and effort: lines in .claude/agents/{agent}.md. The main session uses /model and /effort.

evidence.title: Where it happened
evidence.showMessage: Show the message before this turn
evidence.message: Read from {file} just now. Atlas keeps it only while this panel is open.
evidence.noMessage: No message you typed comes before this turn; an agent started it.
evidence.hidden: This message looks like it holds a key or token, so Atlas does not show it.
evidence.changed: This session file changed or moved after the inspection. Inspect again to open this turn.

compare.pickHint: Pick a date, or a commit that changed agent files
compare.none: Pick a date to compare the days before and after it.
compare.tooFew: Only {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after {date} had 500 turns or more; 3 are needed to judge.
compare.same: No detectable difference: since {date} the daily figure stayed inside the usual range, {low} to {high}.
compare.lower: Lower since {date}: {after} against {before} before, below the usual range.
compare.higher: Higher since {date}: {after} against {before} before, above the usual range.
compare.left: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} with under 500 turns left out.

money.title: Claude Code's estimate
money.note: Claude Code's own estimate from its session files, at API prices. It is not your bill.
money.partial: Claude Code could not price every model, so this estimate is low.
money.none: Claude Code wrote no cost estimate in these sessions.

partial.files: {count, plural, one {# file was} other {# files were}} not read: {reason}. Their figures are not included.
partial.lines: {count, plural, one {# line over 4 MiB was} other {# lines over 4 MiB were}} skipped.
partial.unknown: {count, plural, one {# record had} other {# records had}} a shape Atlas does not know; figures that need them show as unknown.
partial.elsewhere: {count, plural, one {# session file ran} other {# session files ran}} in a folder that is no longer this repository, so they are not counted.

empty.title: No Claude Code sessions for this repository in the last 30 days
empty.body: Atlas looked in {paths}. Claude Code writes a session file there for each conversation.

error.home: Could not read {path}: {reason}. Nothing there was inspected.

web.title: Inspecting token use needs the app
web.body: Claude Code keeps its session files in your home folder, which a browser cannot open. The app reads their counts on this computer.
